walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE Geography specification.

Managing Our Environment appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Managing Our Environment in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Managing Our Environment.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
